description: One thing a worker has to check or do inside one templated task. THE CHECKLIST IS OPTIONAL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: a smoke detector test is a checklist, and 'renew the certificate before it lapses' is not, and forcing the second into the shape of the first produces a one-item list that says 'do the task'. What a row buys where it is right is a completion that cannot be filed with the third item unlooked-at — `item_name` is the KEY the completion names, and `required` is what `complete_farm_task` refuses on. `evidence_type` is a HINT the handset draws from and the backend does not enforce, for the same reason `Inspection Template Section.renderer_hint` is: the refusal lives in the task's evidence contract, where one reader can find all of it.

fields.description: What to check or do, in the words the worker reads on the phone — 'Press the smoke alarm test button and hear it sound', not 'item 3'. IT IS ALSO THE KEY A COMPLETION NAMES, so two items on one template may not share a name: a completion marking 'Test the alarm' done when the template has two of them marks whichever one was read first, and the other stays open for reasons nobody can see.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Whether the task can be completed without this item. A REQUIRED item that is not marked done is refused by complete_farm_task, by name — that is the whole of what a checklist adds over instructions somebody reads and forgets. An OPTIONAL item is how a template that covers more than today needs stays usable: the propane check on a cabin with no propane is skipped rather than falsely ticked.
fields.label: Required

fields.description: What the worker is expected to capture alongside the tick. A HINT AND NOT A CONTRACT: the handset draws a camera for Photo and a number pad for Measurement, and a client that does not know one of these values falls back to a plain tick and the completion is still valid. THE REFUSAL LIVES IN THE TASK'S `evidence_required`, which is checked against what was actually filed — putting a second, weaker evidence gate on a child row would give an operation two places to state one requirement and no way to know which one an auditor is reading.
fields.label: Evidence

fields.description: The order the items are worked in, filled in by the controller when nothing sets it. A real ordering rather than decoration: a detector test that signs the sheet before the alarm is pressed is a sheet signed about an alarm nobody heard.
fields.label: Order

name: Farm Task Template Checklist Item
